kitDescription: Mihara is a Water-element AR Burst-III attacker whose kit escalates with her own burst usage. Her Skill 1 refreshes a 10-second Critical Damage buff on herself every time she empties her 60-round magazine, giving near-continuous uptime. Her Skill 2 builds a two-stage 'Highway to Hell' ladder on each of her own burst casts: the first cast grants 45 seconds of ATK up, and from the second cast onward she also gains Critical Rate up. Her burst deals an immediate 399.6% burst hit to all enemies, shortens the Full Burst window her cast opens from 10 to 5 seconds, and — once Highway to Hell 2 is active (her second cast onward) — adds a further 266.4% hit. The Full Burst shortening is a self-trade: her rotations give the team less +50% window time but cycle back to the next chain sooner.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found on any of the six kit lines: every line is encoded, fires at the prose-implied cadence, and discriminates RED under its named nearest-wrong model (shotFired spam, flat/passive S2, always-on rider, omitted rider, lvl-1 magnitudes, sign-flipped or removed FB line). The three independent derivations converged on the same model — including the two classic traps (burstCast vs fullBurstEnter keying, and the FB▼5s line not being a skippable no-op) — and S2b's one conditional GAP (negative-seconds clamp) was verified false against the engine. Because convergence here is substantially same-shape reasoning, the stability-not-correctness caveat applies, but the discriminating counterfactual suite and the event-frame-level pins (magazine-end set equality, per-cast nuke decomposition, 300f/600f/900f window lengths) are exactly the artifacts that make a shared misread expensive to hide. Two items survive as documented, measurement-gated residuals for the owner to spot-check rather than as verdict blockers: (1) the FB▼5s line's NET effect — the engine's rotation model resolves it net-positive (+10.5% team, an extra full burst per fight) where the blind writer's pristine prior expected net-negative; this is the isabel standing ⚑ and needs a real-footage or battery confirmation before mihara's board number is trusted, since it is a ~10% team-level swing driven by one kit line; (2) the cast-2 onset of the 266.4% rider (same-cast arming via SLOTS dispatch) and the same-cast S2 ATK feeding the same-cast nuke — both plausible, both flagged by the blind side as kit-ambiguous, both settled one recording away. Nothing must change for GO; both residuals are already written into the driver's own caveats and ⚑ list.
